name: Yuganda USO no KOI to letter
original_name: 歪んだ嘘の恋とレッテル
source:
Maki used to be lovers with his childhood friend Saeko and they would imitate what adults would do. However, one time they had sex and she ran away from the town because of it. Immediately he was blamed for the incident and labelled as a ‘monster’. Many years later and now in his second year at school, those rumours have still persisted.

On the day of the final exam for the term in early July, he protected his cousin Yuki from some harassment from some boys and his past label resurfaced. However, this time he gave up trying to deny it and acted like he enjoyed it. Saeko suddenly returned to the town and he also ended up having multiple relationships with many girls by chance. Addicted to the new sensations and pleasure, he seeked many forms of erotic play to express his pent-up anger. At the same time, he was able to see the girls’ true feelings and personality.

Is this pure love or twisted love?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/09/28/september-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
真希曾经和青梅竹马的纱荣子是恋人，他们会模仿成年人的行为。然而，有一次他们发生了性关系，她因此逃离了小镇。他立即被指责为这起事件的罪魁祸首，并被贴上“怪物”的标签。许多年后，现在已经是他上学的第二年了，这些谣言仍然存在。

7月初期末考试那天，他保护表弟由希免受一些男生的骚扰，他过去的标签又重新浮出水面。不过，这一次他不再否认，而是表现得很享受。纱子突然回到小镇，也机缘巧合地与许多女孩发生了多段关系。他沉迷于新的感觉和快乐，寻求多种形式的色情游戏来表达他压抑已久的愤怒。同时，他也能看到女孩们的真实感受和性格。

这是纯粹的爱情还是扭曲的爱情？
